"Um.. i-i would- no! No, i mean, would y-you like something t-to drink? I c-can pay.. uh, i m-must pay."

Paul stutters, flinching when he realizes how stupid he sounded right now. Of course he would be an embarrassing weirdo! If he keeps acting like that, she will never like him back.

He doubts she will, anyways. She's too nice and pretty to like him. He's just some autistic weirdo nerd, he thinks to himself, as his hands shake under the table. He avoids eye contact, wanting to hide his head into a hole. All the stimulation from the room was making him overwhelmed.
